note: Part 1 (named) is always included; part 2 takes the candidates in rank order, skipping any held by fewer than 1,000 stake credentials of the recent frame at the snapshot, until ten qualify; part 3 is computed by the run; part 4 takes every stablecoin and tokenized commodity listed that is held by at least 1,000 of them. A file that lists any unsettled coin is refused by the run.

converted.note: Converted by hand from the 2026-10-22 capture, which predates part 4; no coin was read again. fGLD moved from the part 2 candidates to part 4 under the rulings file commodity ruling, and the part 2 ranks after it moved up by one. The four coins that capture excluded as stablecoins are listed as unsettled, because their Cardano contracts and registry mappings were never read. That capture also read coin details only as far as market position 61 of the ranking, so part 4 may be incomplete. The strata are captured again on the date of the hypotheses record.
